text:
alex.k: Quick FYI — our KB article /kb/runtime/compile-opts has two images returning 404 after yesterday's CDN deploy. Saw them in the site smoke test. Anyone owning that page?

kb-scan-bot: Automated scan: 2 broken image links found in /kb/runtime/compile-opts (ids img-142, img-143). Reported 2026-03-18 14:02 UTC.

maria.docs: thanks @alex.k and @kb-scan-bot. Can you paste the broken URLs? I can open a quick PR to swap to the rotated path if it's just a path prefix change.

alex.k: Here — https://cdn.redwood-inference.com/assets/kb/runtime/compile-opts/figure1.png -> returns 403
and https://cdn.redwood-inference.com/assets/kb/runtime/compile-opts/figure2.png -> 404
Looks like prefix changed to /static/v2/ during the deploy.

sam.engineering: I own that KB (ghost of onboarding). I'll take it. Will open PR to update image paths + add short redirect rule to CDN config. If someone from infra can approve the redirect?

olivia.infra: @sam.engineering I can review the CDN redirect. For quick fix you can run:

```bash
# replace /assets/ with /static/v2/ for this folder
git checkout -b docs/fix/compile-opts-images
sed -i 's#/assets/kb/runtime/compile-opts#/static/v2/kb/runtime/compile-opts#g' content/kb/runtime/compile-opts.md
git add -A && git commit -m "docs(kb): fix image paths for runtime compile opts"
```

I'll queue the CDN redirect after CI artifact deploys.

alex.k: :thumbsup: tagging @maria.docs — can you add yourself as secondary owner? Also can we add a small smoke test to CI to catch image 4xx?

maria.docs: Yep. I'll add a tiny Playwright check that opens the page and asserts images load (200). I'll drop it in the docs-ci PR template. ETA end of day.

kb-scan-bot: Noted: issue assigned to sam.engineering; follow-ups from maria.docs and olivia.infra. Will re-scan in 2 hours.

sam.engineering: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2145 — updates image paths + adds alt-text fix. @olivia.infra @maria.docs plz review. I'll hold on merging until infra gives the redirect green.

olivia.infra: On it. Reviewing now.
